baseline: A0 fixed reference Q, no contrastive loss
single_change: C0 adds response-flip InfoNCE; Q remains fixed
artifact_policy: Per condition: manifest, summary, verification, per-seed metrics and checkpoint; candidate summary includes paired A0 rows copied from baseline_A0.

source.citation: Feng, Heffernan & Koedinger (2009), User Modeling and User-Adapted Interaction.

preparation.selection: Top users and problems by frequency of eligible rows; no score-based ranking.
preparation.filters: Main problems only (original=1), labeled skill_id, non-open-response, valid 0..1 credit.
preparation.score: 1 iff correct=1; all partial credit below 1 maps to 0, as source documentation recommends.
preparation.pair_dedup: Earliest start_time per student-problem; first source row breaks ties.
preparation.q_reference: Union of observed source skill_id tags per selected problem; not expert-validated ground truth.
preparation.q_true_file: Exact copy of Q_matrix.npy for existing runner compatibility; reference Q only.
preparation.id_mapping: Ascending retained raw user_id and problem_id mapped to zero-based IDs.
preparation.split: Per-student seeded random 70/10/20 interaction split after pair dedup.
